intuition: Keep the latest price by timestamp and use lazy heaps to expose the current minimum and maximum.

brute_force.approach: Store prices by timestamp and scan all values for each minimum or maximum query.
brute_force.time: update O(1), current O(1), maximum O(n), minimum O(n)

optimal.approach: Store the timestamp map, a min-heap, and a max-heap; discard heap records that no longer match the map.
optimal.time: update O(log n), current O(1), maximum O(log n) amortized, minimum O(log n) amortized

edge_cases: Updating an existing timestamp invalidates its previous heap entries.
Current price is the price at the greatest timestamp, not the most recent update.
